lemma polynomialQuotientBaseChange_tmul {R K n : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing K]
    [Algebra R K] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial n R)) (p : MvPolynomial n R) :
    polynomialQuotientBaseChange (K := K) I ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk I p) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R K) p) := by
findings.problem: This constructor computation is not registered with simp. The desired normal form of `polynomialQuotientBaseChange I (1 ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk I p)` is the quotient class of the coefficient-mapped polynomial. Mathlib registers the component computations as simp rules, but they are hidden behind this named equivalence. The proof of `countable_model_with_elements` consequently invokes this lemma explicitly at line 371.
findings.proposed_change: Add `@[simp]` to `polynomialQuotientBaseChange_tmul`, retaining its current orientation. Register the computation lemma rather than unfolding `polynomialQuotientBaseChange` globally.
findings.benefit: Allows simplification of the actual representative-transport expression without exposing the equivalence's implementation. The rewrite removes the equivalence application and introduces no reverse rule. It remains valid for the top ideal, trivial coefficient rings, and an empty variable type.
